nights.title: Nights
nights.lede: Review past nights: timelapse, keogram and startrails.

empty.title: No nights yet
empty.body: Nights will appear here as soon as the camera captures its first frames. A night runs from noon to noon.

timelapse.fallback: Your browser cannot play this video. You can download it and open it with a video player.
timelapse.none: This night's timelapse has not been created yet. You can create it now; it takes a few minutes.
timelapse.generating: Creating the timelapse: {n}%. You can keep using the app.
timelapse.generatingUnknown: Creating the timelapse. You can keep using the app.
timelapse.failed: Creating the timelapse stopped before it finished. Try again: a new attempt usually works. If it happens again, check the free disk space on the Live screen.

keogram.none: The keogram for this night is not available.

startrails.none: The startrails for this night are not available.

image.fallback: I cannot load this image. Try again in a moment.

ribbon.title: Frames of the night
ribbon.label: Choose a frame from the night
ribbon.hint: Drag the strip or use the arrow keys to choose a frame.
ribbon.sample: Sample band: the engine has not provided the sun phases yet.

danger.intro: Deleting the night removes its frames, keogram, startrails and timelapse. This cannot be undone.

confirm.title: Delete the night of {date}?
confirm.body: This will delete {frames} ({size}), the keogram, the startrails and the timelapse. This cannot be undone.

nights.notFound: This night cannot be found. It may have been deleted.
